text:
- Overall performance: The company's revenue after eliminations is 244.1 billion, with a gross margin of 39.2% and an EBITDA margin of 15.6%.
- The company that contributes the most to revenue is Wipro GE Healthcare, with 146.56 billion in revenue, while Wipro Kawasaki Precision Machinery, with a gross margin of 35.8% and an EBITDA margin of 14.1%, may need attention to improve its margins.
- Margins are 39.2% for gross margin and 15.6% for EBITDA margin.
- Working capital as of 2024-12-01 is managed with a DSO of 69 days and a DPO of 80 days.
- The top 3 revenue drivers are: everything excluding profit centre EQ, revenue account Sales - Motors & Valves with a revenue change of 4.08 billion (37.9% of total change), revenue account Sales - Motors & Valves excluding profit centre EQ with a revenue change of 2.47 billion (23% of total change), and revenue account Sales - Hydraulic Pumps excluding profit centre EQ with a revenue change of 2.05 billion (19.1% of total change).
